spec.name: Customer home
spec.purpose: Pet parent home: pets with approval status, upcoming bookings, service tiles (Hotel, Daycare, Grooming & Spa, In Home via chat).
logic: R-A01 add a pet before booking

spec.name: Sign in
spec.purpose: Customer sign in (email + password, remember me, forgot password) - D-018 allows improving beyond Figma.

spec.name: Front desk today
spec.purpose: Run the day at one location: KPIs, arrivals / departures / staying / checked out tabs, reservations table with status changes (PIN-gated).
logic: dayBucket()
transitionNeedsPin()

spec.name: Grooming day view
spec.purpose: Groomer columns with appointments by time; drag to reschedule; board view by status.
logic: duration from package + add-on minutes

spec.name: Staff notifications
spec.purpose: Notifications for the signed-in staff user (vaccine proofs submitted, new app bookings, messages).
logic: mark read on open

spec.name: Owner dashboard
spec.purpose: KPIs across locations: revenue, occupancy, arrivals, grooming, pending vaccines, feedback.
logic: sum totals by location and period

spec.name: Ops manual cover
spec.purpose: Business operations manual: who reads what per role, chapters with screenshots and live data blocks.
logic: chapters from docs/ops-manual/*.md at build time

spec.name: Staff PIN login
spec.purpose: Fast staff sign-in with a 4-6 digit PIN; lands on the role home and pins the location for front desk / groomer.
logic: findByPin(pin, holders): hash the PIN (FNV-1a mock) and match employees.pin_hash merged with demo holders.
On success switchUser(userId) and navigate to ROLE_HOME[role]; the LocationProvider pins location-scoped roles.
Wrong PIN clears the pad and shows an error; the real backend rate-limits.

spec.name: Page specs index
spec.purpose: Every route with its page code, surface, built / stub status, roles and spec completeness; opens the inspector for any spec.
logic: specCompleteness(spec) scores 8 checks.
status = PageStub element ? stub : built

spec.name: Design tokens
spec.purpose: Every design value in one place: brand palettes (Petrock purple, Sunset), neutrals, semantic roles per theme, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, motion, booking status hues. Generated into tokens.css.
logic: buildTokensCss() renders :root + [data-brand] x [data-theme] blocks; ThemeProvider sets the attributes.

spec.name: Component library
spec.purpose: Every component with its meta: description, props, states, live usages, accessibility notes, pages that use it and Figma source. Rule: no component without a meta.
logic: componentLibrary globs src/components/**/*.meta.ts.

spec.name: Page specs index
spec.purpose: Every route with its page code, surface, built / stub status, roles and spec completeness; opens the inspector for any spec.
logic: specCompleteness(spec) scores 8 checks.
status = PageStub element ? stub : built

spec.name: Table library
spec.purpose: Every table in the schema grouped by area with row counts, columns and access notes, plus the generic table manager that lists, adds, edits and deletes rows of any table (delete is PIN-gated).
logic: tableRegistry from src/data/schema/*.ts
Base columns (id, location_id, created_at, updated_at) are read-only in the editor.
Delete asks for a manager PIN (R-P01) and writes approvals + audit_log.

spec.name: Business rules registry
spec.purpose: Every business rule with id, category, status (requested / in dev / implemented / deprecated), the pages that use it and its source; owners add new rules here (Settings › Rules) and each page inspector links back.
logic: Code registry (src/rules/*.ts) merged with runtime rows from the rules table; runtime rows win on id.
Adding a rule needs rules.write.

spec.name: Knowledge base
spec.purpose: Kanban, changelog (including pending module drafts) and prompt log in tabs; the project memory.
logic: Changelog header lines (version, date, prompt, codes) are parsed by headerMeta().

spec.name: Component states matrix
spec.purpose: Every component against every quality signal in one grid: tier, number of states, usages, props documented, accessibility notes, pages that use it, Figma source. Gaps (no a11y notes, no usage, unused on any page) are flagged so the library stays honest (R-X81).
layout: StatTiles (components, with a11y notes, used on a page, gaps)
logic: componentLibrary from src/design/library.ts (globbed metas).
gap = no usages, or no a11y notes, or usedBy empty.
coverage % = components without gaps / total.

spec.name: Spec completeness report
spec.purpose: For every route: the fields its PageSpec is missing, references that do not resolve (tables not in the schema, components without a meta, rule ids not in the registry), widths not yet checked (D-016), stubs, duplicate or out-of-range page codes and pages without a menu entry. Export as markdown for docs/qa (R-X80).
layout: ReportTable (DataTable, one row per route, issues listed)
logic: buildSpecReport(getRoutes()) in specReport.ts.
Module of a route = the registry module whose routes array contains it.
Expected module per code from CODE_RANGES (docs/build-plan.md).

spec.name: Data workbench
spec.purpose: The table manager with power tools: inline editing of any editable cell, relations (what this table references and what references it, with one-click row filters), CSV export of the current view and CSV import (insert / upsert) with header mapping and type coercion. Deletes and bulk imports need a manager PIN and every write is audited (R-X84).
layout: PageHeader (table picker, export, import, add row)
TableIndex (cards with relation counts) when no table is chosen
WorkbenchTable (DataTable with InlineCell per column, enum filters, relation filter chip)
logic: Editable cell types from ColumnDef: text, int/numeric/money -> number, bool, enum, date, json; base columns read-only (R-J03).
Relation filter: ?ref=<column>:<id> narrows rows to those pointing at one row.
Import: insert regenerates ids; upsert updates rows whose id exists. More than one row -> PIN first.
Every insert / update / delete writes audit_log with the diff.

spec.name: Layout editor
spec.purpose: Reorder and hide the sections a page declares in its spec.layout, per page code, saved to page_layouts. Pages that call useLayout(spec) render in that order; the spec keeps the section names. Reset returns to the spec order (R-X83).
layout: PageList (routes with customised badge) when no code is chosen
Preview (numbered section outline as the page will render)
logic: applyLayout(spec, row): saved order first, new spec sections appended, hidden filtered to existing names.
Save = update the page_layouts row or insert one; reset = delete it.
Dirty state compares against the saved row.

spec.name: Layout editor
spec.purpose: Reorder and hide the sections a page declares in its spec.layout, per page code, saved to page_layouts. Pages that call useLayout(spec) render in that order; the spec keeps the section names. Reset returns to the spec order (R-X83).
layout: PageList (routes with customised badge) when no code is chosen
Preview (numbered section outline as the page will render)

spec.name: Seed inspector
spec.purpose: What the mock database holds: rows per table, the twelve months of history the dev-quality seed adds (stays, grooms, daycare days, invoices, revenue by month), date coverage, localStorage size, seed version, and reseed. Proves reports have a year of data (R-X86).
layout: StatTiles (tables, rows, bookings, invoices, revenue, storage)
MonthlyCharts (stays, appointments, daycare days, revenue by month)
CoverageTable (per table: rows, first / last created_at, location split)
logic: Months from check_in / starts_at / date over the last 12 months.
Revenue = sum of paid invoices.total per issued_at month.
Storage = JSON.stringify(localStorage petrock.db.v1).length / 1024.

spec.name: Route manifest
spec.purpose: The registry as tooling sees it: every route with module, surface, shell, roles, menu group, params, stub / built, screenshot coverage and code-range check; duplicates and collisions; the window.__petrock manifest as JSON to download for scripts. Hardens what scripts/screenshots.mjs and qa-responsive.mjs consume.
layout: StatTiles (routes, modules, stubs, with nav, parameterised)
Collisions (same path or code across modules)
logic: buildManifest(getRoutes()) from src/app/manifest.ts plus module names from getModules().
Collision = two modules registering one path (registry kept the built one) or one code on two names.

spec.name: Responsive QA report
spec.purpose: The matrix of every route at 360, 390, 768, 1280 and 1920 px in light and dark, as scripts/qa-responsive.mjs last measured it: horizontal scroll, elements that overflow the viewport, console errors and a11y findings per cell. Click a cell for the offenders. Runs are logged in qa_runs (R-X82, D-016).
layout: StatTiles (routes, cells, failing cells, a11y findings)
CellDrawer (offenders, a11y, errors, open in preview)
logic: Report from docs/qa/responsive-report.json (bundled).
cell fail = hscroll or console error; warn = a11y findings only; pass otherwise.
Cells missing from the report show as not checked.

spec.name: Responsive preview
spec.purpose: Any route side by side at the five D-016 widths (or one width at full size) in same-origin iframes, so a builder can check a page at 360 and 1920 without resizing the browser. Picks the route from the manifest; shares the current theme and session.
logic: Frames load ./#<route> and scale down to fit their column; one-width mode renders unscaled with horizontal scroll.
Parameterised routes use sample params (:table -> bookings, :code -> D-03).

spec.name: Accessibility scan
spec.purpose: Loads a route in a same-origin iframe and runs the a11y checks (images without alt, controls without a name, unlabelled inputs, iframe titles, heading order, main landmark, positive tabindex, tiny targets, html lang) live; lists findings with selector and WCAG criterion. The same checks run headless in the responsive QA script (R-X87).
layout: RulesLegend (what each rule checks and its WCAG criterion)
logic: scanA11y(iframe.contentDocument) after load + 400 ms.
Findings capped at 200 per page.

spec.name: Performance budget
spec.purpose: Bundle sizes from the last build (scripts/qa-bundle.mjs writes docs/qa/bundle-report.json) and runtime numbers measured now (seed build time, localStorage size, route count, first render) against the perf_budgets table. Budgets are rows, not constants (R-X85).
logic: bundle metrics from bundle-report.json: js_total_kb, css_total_kb, largest_chunk_kb, assets_count_max, docs_kb.
runtime: seed_ms = time of buildSeed(); localstorage_kb from the persisted db; route_count_max from the manifest; first_render_ms from performance timing.
status: fail > 100 %, warn >= warn_at_percent.

spec.name: Screenshot diff
spec.purpose: Every page code with its captured screenshots: which widths and themes exist, which are missing, and a before / after comparison (split, side by side, blend) between the current capture and one taken with --label=before. Coverage per page code drives the definition of done.
layout: StatTiles (codes with shots, complete, missing dark, without shots)
CompareCard (ImageCompare for the chosen code + width)
logic: Assets from import.meta.glob docs/screenshots/**/*.jpg; file name <width>[-dark][-<label>].jpg.
Complete = 390 + 1280 light; key pages also need dark.

spec.name: Docs search
spec.purpose: Full-text search across every markdown file under docs/ with folder filter, ranked hits (title before body), match counts and highlighted snippets; each hit opens the docs viewer (D-06). Also reachable from the docs sidebar filter.
logic: searchDocs(query, {folder}) in docsSearch.ts strips markdown, scores title x20, path x5, body matches capped at 30.
Query lives in the hash (?q=) so results are linkable.

spec.name: Docs viewer
spec.purpose: Renders every markdown file under docs/ in-app with a folder tree, images and screenshot galleries; prompt files split at "## Response".
logic: docsIndex globs docs/**/*.md (raw) and docs/screenshots + renders images (url).
Figma exports (69 MB) are not bundled; links to them stay as paths.

spec.name: Testing hub
spec.purpose: First screen for the team: open any surface (customer app in a phone frame, front desk per location, owner/admin, ops manual, docs, dev), switch demo user by role, and toggle theme, brand and the builder tool.
layout: HubHeader (brand, theme, brand cycle, dev mode)
SurfaceGrid (customer phone preview, front desk x2, owner/admin, manual, docs, dev)
logic: Picking a role calls switchUser(role) then navigates to ROLE_HOME[role].
Front desk cards pin the demo front-desk user of that location.
Dev toggle only renders for super_admin; theme and brand persist in localStorage (petrock.theme).
notes: Not a customer-facing screen; internal testing entry point (hoy pattern).

spec.name: No access
spec.purpose: Friendly page when the current role cannot open a route; offers the hub to switch demo user or the PIN login.
logic: RequireRole redirects here with ?from=<path>.
